notes: Margin 0.01 nDCG@10 (absolute, per group): the smallest change treated as meaningful in BEIR/MIRACL-style reporting, about 1-1.5% relative at today's 0.76 (scifact) and 0.99 (de) and about a tenth of the lexical->hybrid gaps measured on 2026-11-02 (+0.10 scifact, +0.20 de). alpha 0.05 two-sided, Holm over the collection's groups.
